subject.title: iOS: keychain save fails on fresh install (cal save failed / disconnected because it could not securely save)

question: What redacted real-device OSStatus and signed-build entitlement/access-group evidence is sufficient to authorize a narrow change to the iOS Gateway-token Keychain path?
rationale: The report establishes a severe released-device blocker, but changing credential persistence safely requires native diagnostics that distinguish the actual Security framework failure before implementation.

options.title: Collect signed-device diagnostics
options.body: Capture the failing SecItem operation, numeric OSStatus, exact iOS build, app signing identity, and effective Keychain access-group attributes with all tokens and private identifiers redacted.

options.title: Owner-led live reproduction
options.body: Have an iOS owner reproduce a clean 2026.7.1 installation and inspect the Keychain query and entitlements directly before selecting the repair.

recommendation.title: Collect signed-device diagnostics
recommendation.body: Capture the failing SecItem operation, numeric OSStatus, exact iOS build, app signing identity, and effective Keychain access-group attributes with all tokens and private identifiers redacted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are connected to the current iOS area and already engaged with this issue, making them the clearest owner for obtaining or evaluating real-device proof.
